title: Write and run a Python script
description: Use when creating a small Python script from the terminal: open it in nano, save, run it with python3, print it with cat.
overview: Writes app.py line by line in nano, runs it, then prints the file.

source.title: Write and run a Python script

steps.actions: Run `nano app.py`, type the greet function and the print call, save with Ctrl+O and exit with Ctrl+X.
steps.success_criteria: Back at the prompt with app.py saved.

steps.success_criteria: The four lines of the script are printed.
